reference_query:
MATCH (res:Resolution)-[:REFERENCES]->(cr:CR)
WHERE cr.clausesAffected IS NOT NULL AND trim(cr.clausesAffected) <> ''
MATCH (cr)-[:MODIFIES]->(hub:Spec)
WHERE hub.specRelease IS NULL
MATCH (cr)-[:TARGET_RELEASE]->(target:Release)
WITH DISTINCT res, cr, hub, target,
  [raw IN split(replace(cr.clausesAffected, ';', ','), ',')
   WHERE trim(raw) =~ '(?:[0-9]+\\.)+[A-Za-z]*[0-9]+\\s*-\\s*[0-9]+(?:\\s*\\([Nn][Ee][Ww]\\))?\\s*\\.?'] AS rawRanges
WITH res, cr, hub, target, rawRanges,
  [raw IN rawRanges | {
    lowerAddress: split(replace(trim(split(raw, '(')[0]), ' ', ''), '-')[0],
    upper: toInteger(replace(split(replace(trim(split(raw, '(')[0]), ' ', ''), '-')[1], '.', ''))
  }] AS rangeParts
WITH res, cr, hub, target, rawRanges,
  [part IN rangeParts | {
    lowerAddress: part.lowerAddress, upper: part.upper,
    digits: reduce(out = '', ch IN split(last(split(part.lowerAddress, '.')), '') |
      out + CASE WHEN ch =~ '[0-9]' THEN ch ELSE '' END)
  }] AS digitParts
WITH res, cr, hub, target,
  reduce(cleaned = cr.clausesAffected, raw IN rawRanges | replace(cleaned, raw, '')) AS literalField,
  reduce(ids = [], part IN digitParts |
    ids + [ordinal IN range(toInteger(part.digits), part.upper) |
      substring(part.lowerAddress, 0, size(part.lowerAddress) - size(part.digits)) + toString(ordinal)]) AS rangeIdentifiers
MATCH (sec:Section)-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(rk:Spec)-[:IN_RELEASE_OF]->(hub)
WHERE rk.specRelease = target.releaseName
  AND ((literalField CONTAINS sec.sectionNumber AND
        literalField =~ ('(?s).*(?<![A-Za-z0-9.])\\Q' + sec.sectionNumber + '\\E(?![A-Za-z0-9]|\\.[A-Za-z0-9]).*'))
       OR sec.sectionNumber IN rangeIdentifiers)
RETURN DISTINCT res.resolutionId AS resolutionId, cr.tdocNumber AS tdocNumber, sec.sectionId AS sectionId
ORDER BY resolutionId, tdocNumber, sectionId

rdfs:comment "3GPP Technical Document - base class for all meeting documents"@en .
rdfs:comment "Change Request document that modifies a 3GPP specification (TS/TR). Includes CR, draftCR, and pCR types."@en .

rdfs:comment "A 3GPP Technical Specification (TS) or Technical Report (TR). v4.1 (release-aware, hybrid) — a Spec exists in two roles. (1) ABSTRACT HUB: one node per specNumber (IRI tdoc:spec/{specNumber_}, e.g. tdoc:spec/38_211), no tdoc:specRelease; the stable target of release-blind document references — Tdoc/CR MODIFIES & AFFECTS_CORE_SPEC, TRImpact IMPACTS_SPEC/SPEC_IMPACTED_BY (a CR modifies 'the spec', not a single release). (2) RELEASE-KEYED: one node per (specNumber, release) (IRI tdoc:spec/{specNumber_}/{release}, e.g. tdoc:spec/38_211/Rel-15), carries tdoc:specInRelease + tdoc:specRelease + that release's specVersion; the parent of release-specific Sections (BELONGS_TO_SPEC/HAS_SECTION); linked to its hub via tdoc:inReleaseOf. This hybrid preserves release-blind reference edges intact (no re-keying) while giving each release's Sections a release-keyed parent. Pre-v4.0 had a single specNumber node (latest snapshot); v4.0 had only release-keyed nodes (broke hub references) — v4.1 restores the hub additively."@en .

rdfs:comment "v4.1 (release-aware, hybrid): links a RELEASE-KEYED Spec node (specNumber, release) to its ABSTRACT HUB Spec node (specNumber only). Functional: each release-keyed Spec belongs to exactly one hub. Lets release-blind references resolve to the hub while Sections attach to the release-keyed parent; release-blind aggregation CQs traverse hub ← inReleaseOf ← release-keyed → Section. Neo4j relation type IN_RELEASE_OF."@en ;

rdfs:comment "v4.1 (release-aware, hybrid): inverse of tdoc:inReleaseOf — an ABSTRACT HUB Spec node to its RELEASE-KEYED variants (one per release present in the corpus). 0..* (a spec lacking a frozen final for some release has no variant there)."@en ;
rdfs:comment "Section unique identifier. v4.0 (release-aware) pattern: {specNumber}-{release}-{sectionNumber}, e.g., 38.214-Rel-15-5.1.3.2 (pre-v4.0: {specNumber}-{sectionNumber})."@en ;

question_en: Return the top-level sections of spec 38.331 that CRs modify (CR-target layout).
reference_query:
MATCH (cr:CR)-[:MODIFIES]->(hub:Spec {specNumber:'38.331'})
WHERE hub.specRelease IS NULL
WITH DISTINCT hub
MATCH (rk:Spec)-[:IN_RELEASE_OF]->(hub)
MATCH (s:Section {level:1})-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(rk)
RETURN DISTINCT s.sectionId AS sectionId
